answer: Price each identity as a slow-ripening vine that bears reward only after several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts, each endorsement a hard chip of marble no wallet can mint in bulk. A sybil fleet forked from one root shares one funding cluster, so its endorsements trace back to that single root and its vine never fruits; honest standing spreads like saffron threads from many distinct crocuses. The farm must buy a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, cost linear per sybil, while honest pays once.
